courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 雙曲拱壩拱座分析
related.titleEn: Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams
related.transfer: 可遷移「堆石孔隙與密實」與「斜面水壓與合力」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；雙曲拱壩拱座分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Rockfill voids and density" and "Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦堆石變形、混凝土面板與周邊接縫的相容；雙曲拱壩拱座分析則以拱推力、岸坡楔體與壩岩相容的三維判讀為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on compatibility of rockfill deformation, concrete facing and perimeter joints; Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams centres on three-dimensional interpretation of arch thrust, abutment wedges and dam-rock compatibility, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「堆石孔隙與密實」與「薄拱膜力初估」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雙曲拱壩拱座分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Rockfill voids and density” and “Thin-arch membrane estimate”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Closure temperature and joint closure", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 混凝土面板堆石壩施工
history.text: 混凝土面板堆石壩把防滲和承載功能交給不同材料，面板、墊層、堆石與趾板必須在變形後仍保持相容與連續。反濾層標準章節更新，聚焦顆粒保持與區域界面。 土石壩設計與施工章節更新，連結材料、填築與品質控制。 滲流與監測章節更新，提供服役水壓及行為判讀背景。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: Concrete-face rockfill dams assign sealing and support to different materials. Facing, cushion, rockfill and plinth must remain compatible and continuous after deformation. The protective-filter standard is updated, emphasizing particle retention and zone interfaces. Embankment design and construction chapters are updated to connect materials, placement and quality control. Seepage and monitoring chapters are updated, supporting interpretation of service pressures and behavior. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.
